method: Wave one interview evidence on each of the seven principles was rated high / medium / low per Pathfinder (Homeless Link fidelity method, 'qualitatively assessed', p.4 (PDF 27)); the synthesis counts principles rated high or high/medium across projects (p.30).

Four of the 21 follow-up survey respondents were purposively sampled 'to showcase the variability of changes in service use' and their survey responses and costed service use written up as narrative case studies (p.143-144).
